individual-data-points.explanation: The main graphs plot individual intensity measurements over time (scatter points per experiment) together with fitted model curves; the insets are averaged line-plot traces, a plot type exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets show error bars on the averaged early time-point data (euchromatin/heterochromatin), but the caption never states what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
